Container.Name: cortex
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted homelab log intelligence. Cortex receives syslog (UDP/TCP 1514) and OTLP telemetry, stores it in SQLite with full-text search, and exposes it through MCP, REST, a CLI, and a browser investigation workspace.
Set CORTEX_TOKEN (MCP/machine ingest) and CORTEX_API_TOKEN (REST) before first start; the web port is reachable on your LAN, so both are required. Point your Unraid syslog server (Settings > Syslog) or other forwarders at port 1514.

Config.Name: Web UI / MCP / REST port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web workspace, /mcp, REST API, OTLP (/v1/logs, /v1/metrics, /v1/traces) and /health.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: SQLite database (WAL mode). Keep on a cache/SSD share.

Config.Name: Log tail root
Config.Description: Read-only root for managed file-tail ingest. Only paths under this mount can be tailed.

Config.Name: MCP / ingest token
Config.Description: Bearer token for MCP and machine ingest. Required because the server binds beyond loopback. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: REST API token
Config.Description: Token for the REST API. Required for the server to start. Use a value different from the MCP token.

Config.Name: Admin API token
Config.Description: Optional token for privileged REST operations.

Config.Name: Bind host
Config.Description: Address the HTTP server binds inside the container. Leave at 0.0.0.0 so the Docker port mapping works.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host header allow-list (add your Unraid hostname/IP with port, e.g. tower:3100) if requests are rejected.

Config.Name: File tail allowed roots
Config.Description: Container paths file-tail ingest may read.

Config.Name: Home directory
Config.Description: Fixed to the Cortex home mount.
